what_this_is: Einstein+Λ (SdS) ⇒ cosmological first law T dS + dM = 0. The minus sign is derived, not copied from AdS.
what_is_P: On SdS, dr_c/dM|_0 = -1 and T dS + dM = 0. Einstein+Λ implies the GH minus sign.
what_is_not_P: A CFT dual. FGHMV for a net of balls in dS. A derivation of the value of Λ. A Nobel theorem.
